canonical_project: Microsoft data center campus Petit-Landau / Hombourg
notes: Microsoft mega data center on communes of Petit-Landau and Hombourg (Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération), 3 buildings, with RTE grid partnership. MRAe (Mar 2026) flagged incomplete dossier and recommended suspending permit instruction (consumption ~80% of Haut-Rhin household electricity). Unique public inquiry (autorisation environnementale + permits) opened 1 Jun 2026; M2A gave favorable opinion. Construction start planned end Q1 2027, first building in service 2030, full site 2032. Capacity not disclosed.
